payload.title: The file-name token rule makes any document named plan, spec, audit and the like a record unless it carries the ARIA-LIVE-AUTHORITY banner, so docs/plans/sensor-rust-migration/PLAN.md, which CLAUDE.md and ADR-025 cite as the live plan, has 7 stale path references that the adapter no longer reports, and nothing pins that cited-as-live documents stay scanned
evidence: tools/aria-adapters/doc-staleness-adapter.ts:350-361 (RECORD_NAME_TOKENS holds plan, spec, audit, report, review and four more words, matched against the base name only)
tools/aria-adapters/doc-staleness-adapter.ts:384-388 (the only document-level escape is the ARIA-LIVE-AUTHORITY banner in the first 5 lines)
tools/aria-adapters/doc-staleness-adapter.ts:397-401 (token branch of isPointInTimeRecord, skipped only when the banner is present; an explicit Status of Accepted or Normative is not consulted)
CLAUDE.md:49 (the architecture map names docs/plans/sensor-rust-migration/PLAN.md as the plan of the sensor-ingestion sidecar)
docs/adr/025-rust-sidecar-architecture.md:141 (ADR-025 lists the same PLAN.md as the full migration plan)

docs/plans/sensor-rust-migration/PLAN.md:58-60 (invariant table rows name apps/sensor-service/src/ingestion/batch-processor.service.ts, which no longer exists, and apps/sensor-service/src/cache/sensor-topic-cache.service.ts, which now lives under ingestion/)
docs/plans/sensor-rust-migration/PLAN.md:121 (names tools/scripts/check-codec-drift.sh; the repo file is tools/scripts/check-codec-drift.ts)
docs/adr/037-plan-limit-ssot.md:1-3 (Status Accepted, and plan here means the subscription plan, yet the base name makes it a record)
payload.rule_violated: A missing path is stale only where a live document claims it exists (doc-staleness-adapter.ts header, ARIA-HIGH-212); a record classification must follow the document's own role, and the repo already has one mechanism for a document that stays live despite its name (the ARIA-LIVE-AUTHORITY banner) with no pin that the documents CLAUDE.md cites as current use it.
payload.notes: isPointInTimeRecord returns true for docs/plans/sensor-rust-migration/PLAN.md only because the base name holds the token plan (reproduced at a81bfa2d6 by running the adapter's exported functions over the revision's tree). The adapter counts it in recordDocs and never emits its 7 references (58, 60, 121, 122, 274, 364, 372; four are verifiable renames or moves (lines 60, 121, 274, 364) and the rest name files that no longer exist) although CLAUDE.md:49 and ADR-025 send readers to it as the live plan. The same rule makes docs/adr/037-plan-limit-ssot.md (Status Accepted), docs/aria/MISSION_SPEC.md (normative), docs/architecture/audit-tables.md (AUTHORITATIVE) and the runbooks edge-audit-forensics.md and product-audit-invocation.md records through a topic word; none has a missing reference today, so the loss there is silent future recall. Across the tree 29 documents are records by name alone and 68 stale references in 11 of them (a replay of the adapter functions over the revision) are not reported; the banner half of this problem was fixed for docs/aria/SPEC.md by 65204058b. Close condition: Read a document's own live header (the ARIA-LIVE-AUTHORITY banner, or a Status of Accepted, Normative or Authoritative) before the name token in isPointInTimeRecord, give PLAN.md such a header, and add a real-tree test that every docs path cited in CLAUDE.md is not read as a record; proof is the adapter test with a fixture for each header and the real-tree test green, with PLAN.md's 7 references repaired so the adapter reports no finding for it while it is scanned live. Verified at origin/main a81bfa2d6.
